paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者在清醒时段前半段愿意开始拼图，却因光线更合适而把绘画留到晚些。较早开始的偏好可以依活动而异；愿意开始、实际开始与完成质量也不同。两个生活钟点不同的人即使均值相同，也不能据此安排同一工作班次。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional reader wants to start a puzzle in the earlier part of their waking day but leaves drawing until better light is available later. Timing preference can differ by activity. Willingness, actual initiation and quality also differ. Equal means across different waking schedules justify no common work shift.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡：“只谈虚构的拼图和绘画：哪项条件改变了较早开始的吸引力？哪些时间约束还不知道？”可只读，不必透露睡眠时间、调整起床或邀请别人同步日程。听者不把较早偏好当自律、健康或产出证据。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card asks which conditions change the appeal of an earlier start in the fictional puzzle and drawing activities, and which constraints remain unknown. Reading alone suffices, without disclosing sleep times, changing waking time or synchronising schedules. Earlier preference proves no discipline, health or productivity.

paragraphs.zh: 新增情境与讨论卡由费马编辑部原创，可只读，也可跳过原有观察。按过去两周实际经验评价符合程度：1至5，3为部分符合／视情况，不是频率或缺失；没有合适机会或不想评价可不评分。二十题都需回应，四组各五题直接等权，无反向。每组至少三项数字，用和除以数字项数，显示一位小数；2、3、4、4与未评分为13÷4＝3.3，两项数字不给该组均值，其他组照常显示。三项规则是编辑完整性约定，小数位不代表测量精度。四均值不相加、不排名、不派型；缺少记录不等于缺少偏好，相同均值可有不同题目组合，变化不证明成长或练习效果。本原创自报尚未建立信效度、常模或双语等值；不测作息型、心流、生理精力、健康、表现或恢复能力。四篇全文始终可读；原有页面内存、自选24小时标签页草稿及完成、退出、重测清除保持不变，复制只含公开标题与入口。
paragraphs.en: FermatMind Editorial authored these added scenes and discussion cards. Reading alone suffices and existing observations are optional. Rate how well statements describe actual experience over the past two weeks: 1–5, with three meaning partly / depends, not frequency or missingness. No suitable opportunity or withholding remains unscored. All twenty prompts require responses. Four groups of five use direct equal ratings without reversals. Each needs at least three numeric responses; sum divided by numeric count is displayed to one decimal. Ratings 2, 3, 4, 4 and unscored give 13/4 = 3.3. Two numeric answers yield no mean for that group; other sufficient groups remain. The minimum is an editorial completeness rule and decimal display establishes no precision. Four means are neither added, ranked nor used for types. Missing records establish no missing preference; equal means can contain different item patterns and changes establish no growth or practice effect. This original self-report has no established reliability, validity, norms or bilingual equivalence, and measures neither chronotype, flow, biological energy, health, performance nor recovery capacity. All four full guides remain available. Existing page memory, optional 24-hour tab drafts and completion, exit or retake clearing remain unchanged; copying includes only the public title and entry.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者把一份短说明分成选例、写作和检查三个可见阶段，却常在阶段之间选择继续。喜欢保留停止的选择，不等于实际频繁休息。另一个人可能因重新准备成本而选择连续做完；本题均值无法评定哪种安排效率更高。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional reader gives a short explanation three visible stages: choosing examples, writing and checking. They often choose to continue between stages. Wanting the option to stop differs from actually pausing often. Another reader prefers continuity because setup takes effort; this mean cannot decide which arrangement is more efficient.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡：“这份虚构说明的停顿点是完成一块内容，还是固定分钟数？如果继续更方便，是否仍可继续？”可只读，不必执行计时或记录产出。不要从偏好推断耐力，也不要替同伴规定工作休息比例。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card asks whether the fictional explanation has a content boundary or a fixed duration, and whether continuing remains possible. Reading alone suffices without timing sessions or measuring output. A preference establishes no stamina and prescribes no work–rest ratio for someone else.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者需要两份参考并排修改一段文字，暂时收起无关通知，却保留约好的协作提问渠道。材料多不必是干扰，信息变化也可能是任务必要部分。更愿投入不证明准确性提高或进入心流，更不能据此限制别人使用共享空间。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional reader needs two references side by side while revising a paragraph. They put irrelevant notifications aside but keep an agreed collaboration channel open. Multiple materials need not be distractions; changing information can be necessary. Feeling readier proves neither accuracy nor flow and authorises no restriction of a shared space.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡：“只看虚构修改任务：哪些信息是必要输入，哪些可稍后处理？谁还需要参与约定？”可只读。若愿尝试，只选可撤销且不影响责任的小变化；更好的一次感受不建立因果，也不证明理想环境。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card distinguishes necessary inputs from deferrable information in the fictional revision, and asks who needs to join any agreement. Reading alone suffices. Any optional change is reversible and respects obligations; one better-feeling session establishes neither causation nor an ideal environment.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者本来就要在两项兴趣活动之间离开片刻，回来后更愿开始下一项，但旧任务仍很难。另一天，暂停后收到的新提示也可能改变投入感。愿意继续是自报经验，不是身体精力、注意恢复或效率的实测变化。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a fictional reader takes an already planned pause between hobbies and feels readier for the next activity, while the earlier task remains difficult. On another day, new information after the pause could also change readiness. Reported willingness is no observed change in physical energy, restored attention or efficiency.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论卡：“在虚构活动中，暂停前后除时间经过外，还改变了什么？愿意开始和任务变容易是同一件事吗？”可只读，不需要安排额外休息、分享健康状况或反复测验。较少认同不表示不需要休息，也不用于排除真实困扰。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion card asks what besides elapsed time changed in the fictional activity, and distinguishes readiness from an easier task. Reading alone suffices without extra breaks, health disclosures or repeated testing. Lower endorsement establishes no lack of need for rest and dismisses no actual concern.
